title: Payroll pay preview with benefits fallback
name: Pay preview service

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code degrades when the benefits service is unavailable? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The benefits call times out. What does the returned preview contain?
choices: A preview with taxCents computed on the full gross, no deductions, and netCents set to null
An exception propagated to the caller because the timeout rejects
A preview whose netCents equals gross minus tax, treating deductions as zero
A preview with taxCents set to 0 and netCents null

questions.prompt: Why is netCents set to null rather than computed when a dependency is missing?
choices: Because the tax estimator cannot run without deductions
To avoid showing an employee a net pay figure that overstates what they will actually receive
Because JSON serialization fails on partial numbers
To force the client to retry the request immediately

questions.prompt: When the benefits service hangs for 5 seconds, what happens to the underlying fetch after withTimeout rejects?
choices: It is aborted when the timer fires
It is aborted by clearTimeout in finally
It keeps running in the background until it settles; its result is ignored
It causes an unhandled promise rejection that crashes the process
